title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, AI Hypercomputer, and Prebuilt AI
bodyMarkdown:
## Provisioning AI and ML Infrastructure

Modern architectures increasingly include ML workloads. The PCA must know how to provision the **Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform** (the rebranded Vertex AI), the **AI Hypercomputer** supercomputing architecture, accelerators, and the prebuilt AI APIs that deliver value without training models.

### Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI)

The unified platform for the ML lifecycle:

- **Pipelines** — serverless, reproducible ML **DAGs** (built on Kubeflow Pipelines/TFX) for preprocessing, training, evaluation, and conditional deployment, with artifact/metadata **lineage**, caching, and metric-gated steps.
- **Training and Prediction** — custom and prebuilt training, online/batch prediction endpoints, autoscaling serving.
- **Feature Store, Model Registry, Experiments** — manage features, versioned models, and runs.
- **Data integration** — connect BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and streaming sources as pipeline inputs.
- **AI Agents / Agent Builder** — build grounded, tool-using agents; **NotebookLM** is a grounded research/assistant tool in the Gemini Enterprise family.

### AI Hypercomputer and accelerators

**AI Hypercomputer** is Google's integrated supercomputing architecture: performance-optimized hardware, high-bandwidth/low-latency networking, dense (liquid-cooled) pods, and a tuned software stack for large-scale training and serving.

- **Cloud TPUs** — Google's purpose-built accelerators for large-scale training/inference.
- **GPUs** — broad framework compatibility for training and serving.
- **Capacity** — use **Reservations** or **Dynamic Workload Scheduler (DWS)** to secure scarce accelerators; orchestrate large clusters with managed tooling.

### Consumption models for ML

- **On-demand** accelerators for experimentation.
- **Committed Use / Reservations** for steady training capacity.
- **Spot** accelerators for fault-tolerant training jobs.
- **Pay-per-call APIs** for managed model endpoints and prebuilt services.

### Prebuilt AI solutions and APIs

When you don't need a custom model, reach for managed APIs (usage-priced, no infrastructure to run):

| API / solution | Capability |
|----------------|-----------|
| Cloud Vision | Label/object detection, OCR, safe-search |
| Cloud Video Intelligence | Label, shot, object, content moderation in video |
| Speech-to-Text / Text-to-Speech | Transcription and synthesis |
| Natural Language | Entity, sentiment, syntax |
| Translation | Language translation |
| Vertex AI Search & Conversation | Enterprise search, RAG, chat assistants |
| Document AI | Structured extraction from documents |

**Model Garden** is the catalog to discover, test, tune, and deploy first-party (**Gemini**), open, and third-party models. **Gemini Cloud Assist** brings AI help into cloud operations (design, troubleshoot, optimize).

### Best practices

- Start with **prebuilt APIs**; move to **Model Garden**/tuned models when customization is needed.
- Orchestrate repeatable ML work with **Pipelines** (not ad-hoc scripts) for reproducibility and lineage.
- Right-size accelerators and secure capacity with reservations/DWS; use Spot for interruptible training.
